items.headline: Chipotle options flow shows put-heavy positioning ahead of October earnings By Investing.com
items.summary: Investing.com -- Chipotle Mexican Grill Inc (CMG) is $30.99, down 4.23% (as of Oct 5, 10:24 AM EDT). Options volume of 120,285 contracts is dominated by puts: 100,930 puts against 19,355 calls, roughly 5.2 puts per call.

items.headline: Watch: Quarterly Earnings Reports May Be Over Soon. Is That Bad News For Investors?
items.summary: In this week's episode of WSJ's Take On the Week, former SEC enforcement attorney Marc Steinberg explains why the SEC's proposal to allow publicly held companies to elect semi-annual reporting could impact U.S. capital markets.
